did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. Rahim Traders opened "More photos" on his phone case and added two photos, one at a time. A shop buyer then opened the product page, tapped the thumbnails, and tapped the big photo.

checks.text: The seller can add up to five more photos, and sees each with "Main" and "Remove"
The buyer sees the main photo with two thumbnails under it; tapping a thumbnail changes the big photo
Tapping the big photo opens it large, with a Close button

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script. The file picker of the pane cannot open a system dialog, so the two sample pictures were attached to the file field from the page itself.

shots.caption: The seller added two more photos: Side view and Back view
The buyer sees the main photo and two thumbnails
Tapping Side view changes the big photo
Tapping the big photo opens it large, with Close
